objects.text:
ONEOMICS Private Limited is a genomics company
delivering end-to-end solutions across sequencing
services, sample collection and preservation
products, nucleic-acid extraction and library-prep
kits, and bioinformatics software.
objects.name: page1.text.5

objects.text:
From a single saliva sample to a full metagenome,
our integrated portfolio helps researchers, clinicians
and agri-scientists move from sample to insight with
confidence.
objects.name: page1.text.10

objects.text:
To make high-quality genomic science
accessible by providing reliable sequencing
services, robust sample-stabilization products
and dependable molecular tools.
objects.name: page1.text.13

objects.text:
To be a trusted partner in genomics, enabling
discoveries that advance human health,
agriculture and the environment.
